title: Presidential candidates' schedules feature debates and rallies
subtitle: Check out the candidates' official engagements this Friday.
excerpt: Presidential candidates are fulfilling a busy schedule with debates, campaign rallies, interviews, and meetings this Friday.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Official campaign engagements

The schedules of the presidential candidates this Friday (21) feature a series of activities focused on the electoral race. Contenders for the nation's highest executive office are dedicating the day to various public engagements.

Activities scheduled for the date include participation in debates, campaign rallies, interviews granted to media outlets, and official meetings with representatives from various sectors of society.

Dynamics of the electoral calendar

Within the context of the Brazilian democratic process, the candidates' public schedules are a fundamental part of promoting proposals and engaging with the electorate. Public events and media appearances are part of the regular flow of activities permitted and expected during the campaign period regulated by the country's electoral laws.

With information from Agência Brasil.
